description:
Search documentation with hybrid semantic (vector) and keyword (BM25) search. Use semanticWeight to choose keyword-only (0), semantic-only (1), or a blend; mid values fuse rankings with RRF. Supports Tiger Cloud (TimescaleDB), PostgreSQL, and PostGIS.

A hit is one chunk of a page, often part of a larger section: a table row without its header, one step of a procedure. Before answering from a hit, read it in context: get_context with the hit's chunk_id returns the whole section it is in, and from there its parent section, the page and the page's outline. For exact figures (limits, prices, plan features) prefer keyword-heavy searches (semanticWeight 0–0.3) that use the words the docs would use.

limit.description: The maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 20.

query.description: The search query. Used for BM25 when keyword or hybrid search applies, and for the embedding when semantic or hybrid search applies.

semanticWeight.description: Controls the balance between semantic and keyword search. 0 = keyword only, 0.5 = equal mix, 1 = semantic only. Default is 0.7 (favor semantic search).

source.description: The documentation source to search. "tiger" for Tiger Cloud and TimescaleDB, "postgres" for PostgreSQL, "postgis" for PostGIS spatial extension. Specific versions provided with _X.X suffixes.

name: search_docs

chunk_id.description: Id of this chunk. Pass it to get_context to read the whole section the chunk is in.

content.description: The content of the documentation entry.

distance.description: The distance score indicating the relevance of the entry to the query. Lower values indicate higher relevance.

headings.description: Heading path of the section, page title first.

id.description: The unique identifier of the documentation entry.

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the documentation entry, as a JSON encoded string.

page_id.description: Id of the page this chunk is on (get_context: the page and its outline).

section_id.description: Id of the section this chunk is part of (get_context).

url.description: Link to the section on the docs site.
